doc.baseListItem_prop_active: If true, the item will be rendered in an active/highlighted state.
doc.baseListItem_prop_asChild:
If true, the item will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
Use when the list item must be a specific element (e.g. `<li>` inside `<ul>`).
doc.baseListItem_prop_danger: If true, the item will be styled to indicate a dangerous or destructive action.
doc.baseListItem_prop_disabled: If true, the item will be rendered in a disabled state and become non-interactive.
doc.baseListItem_prop_icon: Left icon or element to display before the children.
doc.baseListItem_prop_rightSection: Right section (e.g., shortcuts, arrows, status indicators) to display after the children.
doc.feedbackCloseButton_prop_ariaLabel: ARIA label for accessibility. Defaults to translated "Close" label.
doc.feedbackCloseButton_prop_id: Optional identifier for the target being closed (e.g., Toast ID).
doc.feedbackCloseButton_prop_onClose:
Callback fired when the close button is clicked.
If not provided, the button will not be rendered (returns null).
doc.feedbackIcon_prop_icon: Custom icon node. If false, no icon will be rendered.
doc.fieldCharacterCount_prop_alwaysShow: Whether to show the count even if count is 0
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_className: Additional CSS class name for the container.
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_label: The main label text or element.
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_optionalLabel:
Custom text or element for the optional badge.
@default "optional"
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_required: Whether the field is mandatory. If true, displays a required badge.
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_requiredLabel:
Custom text or element for the required badge.
@default "required"
doc.fieldLabelContent_prop_showOptional:
Whether to display an optional badge when `required` is false.
@default false
doc.indicatorBase_prop_asChild:
If true, the indicator will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
@default false
doc.indicatorBase_prop_children: Content to be rendered inside the indicator.
doc.indicatorBase_prop_content: Content to be rendered inside the indicator (alternative to children).
doc.indicatorBase_prop_icon: Optional icon to display before the children.
doc.indicatorBase_prop_interactive:
Whether the indicator is interactive (shows hover/active states).
@default false
doc.indicatorBase_prop_styles: Mapping of class names from a CSS module to apply theme-specific styling.
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_activeSelector:
CSS selector used to identify the currently active element within the parent container.
The slider will position itself relative to this element.
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_className: Additional CSS class name for the slider element.
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_dependence: Dependency value that triggers a repositioning when changed (e.g., active tab ID).
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_orientation:
Whether the slider moves horizontally or vertically.
@default "horizontal"
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_style: Custom Inline styles for the slider element.
doc.indicatorSlider_prop_variant: Visual variant of the slider. Maps to CSS Module classes.
doc.overlayBase_prop_ariaModal:
Whether the overlay should be treated as a modal for assistive technologies.
@default true
doc.overlayBase_prop_children:
Content to be rendered inside the overlay. 
Usually wrapped in a focus trap.
doc.overlayBase_prop_closeOnEscape:
Whether to trigger onOpenChange(false) when pressing the Escape key.
@default true
doc.overlayBase_prop_closeOnOverlayClick:
Whether to trigger onOpenChange(false) when clicking the backdrop.
@default true
doc.overlayBase_prop_contentClassName: Custom class name for the content wrapper element.
doc.overlayBase_prop_onOpenChange: Callback fired when the overlay state changes (e.g., closing via Escape key or backdrop click).
doc.overlayBase_prop_open: Whether the overlay is currently visible.
doc.overlayBase_prop_overlayClassName: Custom class name for the root backdrop element.
doc.overlayBase_prop_overlayTransitionProps:
Configuration for the backdrop transition.
@see Transition
doc.overlayBase_prop_role:
ARIA role for the content wrapper.
@default "dialog"
doc.overlayBase_prop_transitionProps:
Configuration for the content transition.
@see Transition
doc.statusContent_prop_actions: Action elements (e.g., buttons, links) typically rendered at the bottom.
doc.statusContent_prop_className: Additional CSS class name for the root element.
doc.statusContent_prop_icon: Main icon representing the status or state.
doc.statusContent_prop_prefixCls: Custom class name prefix for the root element.
doc.statusContent_prop_size:
Size variation of the content and icons.
@default "md"
